11028|ea44f66d.name: Jemma Quikswitch
11028|ea44f66d.text: I heard the new Henweigh 6000 will be rolling off the assembly line soon. I can barely contain my excitement!

11065|03886821.name: Thonys Pillarstone
11065|03886821.text: Ah, ye're an inquisitive one, are ye'? Excellent! Pay close attention, this just might save yer skin when the goin' gets rough!

11065|9c1c73ea.name: Thonys Pillarstone
11065|9c1c73ea.text: There are ways to strengthen steel beyond the hammer and forge, young wanderer. Care to learn more?

11870|3a5c3d7e.name: Archibald
11870|3a5c3d7e.text: I suppose you are here to be trained in the use of a new weapon?  Make it fast, I'm very busy!

1226|5d01ce11.name: Maxan Anvol
1226|5d01ce11.text: I hope the Light is with you, $N. Is there anything I can do for you today?

1234|ea9bf72c.name: Hogral Bakkan
1234|ea9bf72c.text: Can't help ya, $N. I only train rogues.

1241|4a926ca6.name: Tognus Flintfire
1241|4a926ca6.text: Good day to ye lad. Can I be of service?

1247|b63e4e81.name: Innkeeper Belm
1247|b63e4e81.text: Fill yer tankard and pull up a chair. We've stories to tell and kegs to empty.

1252|83b3b21e.name: Senir Whitebeard
1252|83b3b21e.text: Greetings and salutations to you, good $r. P'rhaps you'd like to share a drink with me, help fight off the chill of the wind? Come, I've more than enough to share.

1253|a23f7e7e.name: Father Gavin
1253|a23f7e7e.text: Welcome, $c, to the Misty Pine. If you are weary from your travels, feel free to rest and warm yourself inside. And perhaps if you've some spare time, you could assist me in some tasks.

1374|61386298.name: Rejold Barleybrew
1374|61386298.text:
Curse that Brewers' League!  They have access to all the best ingredients, while we're stuck here grubbing for grain and hops!

I really would like to give them some bitter tasting justice...

14729|9e055276.name: Ralston Farnsley
14729|9e055276.text:
You there... it is in your best interest to aid the Forsaken during these dire times.  Listen closely, as I dislike repeating myself.

We currently find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  Bandages and simple textiles are running low, and donations are being accepted to bolster sagging inventories.  While you'll not receive financial compensation - hence what donation means - your aid will not go unnoticed.

1699|0c543544.name: Gremlock Pilsnor
1699|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

1699|b48f927f.name: Gremlock Pilsnor
1699|b48f927f.text: I can teach you how to cook!

1700|c2467ddc.name: Paxton Ganter
1700|c2467ddc.text: I can teach you fishing skills.

1703|112fe3e7.name: Uthrar Threx
1703|112fe3e7.text: Welcome to me shop. What can I do for ye'?

1703|d69277e0.name: Uthrar Threx
1703|d69277e0.text: Excellent! I've been hopin' for a new student. Well, let's get started right away then!

1937|19122c56.name: Apothecary Renferrel
1937|19122c56.text: The Dark Lady has put the challenge forth. Now it is up to the Royal Apothecary Society to develop a new plague. We shall bring Arthas and his wretched army to their knees.

2132|db927cdf.name: Carolai Anise
2132|db927cdf.text: Nice to see a friendly face. I don't get much chitchat from Apothecary Johaan unless he wants something. He's been out of the grave too long. Someday I'll be like that, I hear. Creepy. Maybe by then I won't care.

2226|dd7de3ae.name: Karos Razok
2226|dd7de3ae.text: Greetings.  Our bats are well trained and fed.  You'll not find faster.

2326|a28d29e1.name: Thamner Pol
2326|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

246389|8e0ab317.name: Hilda the Breaker
246389|8e0ab317.text:
Why do they call me "The Breaker"?

Trust me, you don't want to know.

258785|726390d0.name: High Priestess Mims
258785|726390d0.text: Surrender to the Light, $N. How can I help you serve today?

267008|b4ea9d59.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
267008|b4ea9d59.text: They named it Bandarion Keep. I wonder what Garek would make of that?

271546|7dbe534f.name: Mountaineer Gretchen
271546|7dbe534f.text:
Lookin' fer the courier? Just flew off like a wee bird.

Can't say I blame the poor sod. These wendigos are nasty business.

272526|bf500b92.name: Glix Xizzix
272526|bf500b92.text:
Yes, I am the renowned trader who magnanimously fed the uh, starving... children...? ...of the Undercity during the recent war with the Scourge. Yes, I am the visionary businessgob and logistical genius who single-handedly armed the resistance and allowed our Dark Lady to found her nation of smelly corpses... um, I mean, "Forsaken."

Yep, I'm him. Glix Xizzix. I'd be happy to sign an autograph. For a small fee, of course.

What am I doing here running a barbershop, you ask? Well I got one word for you, bub--diversification. You've got to keep your revenue streams diversified!

3557|1f4f702f.name: Guillaume Sorouy
3557|1f4f702f.text: You have learned well my child. Go to the Undercity, find a smith named James Van Brunt. He will be able to teach you much that I cannot. I understand he spends his time near the Warriors training hall, forging their weapons and armor.

4551|d37b59d0.name: Michael Garrett
4551|d37b59d0.text: How may I be of service?

4556|3dfe0528.name: Gordon Wendham
4556|3dfe0528.text: Greetings, and welcome.  I am not very good at smiling, but trust me; I am happy to serve you.

4591|a28d29e1.name: Mary Edras
4591|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

4596|b22b0c37.name: James Van Brunt
4596|b22b0c37.text: How is the edge of your steel? Good enough to cut through the belly of your enemy? Let me show you some things to make it even sharper.

4605|e9a5758c.name: Basil Frye
4605|e9a5758c.text: You have learned much, more than I can teach. Go to James Van Brunt, he will teach you what I cannot.

5153|65dd6697.name: Jormund Stonebrow
5153|65dd6697.text: Ah, this Darnassian fabric is the finest!

5153|ab3a58ee.name: Jormund Stonebrow
5153|ab3a58ee.text: I don't have time to babysit! Go talk to me assistant, Uthrar!

5595|3e1ee680.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|3e1ee680.text:
Ye might not know it, but in addition to being a skilled tailor, Jormund is also a slayer of giants!  Why he must have overheard a few of us sharing stories when he shouted that he'd killed seven with one blow!  

Ye should pay him a visit at his store on the north side of The Great Forge an' see if he'll tell ye the tale!

5595|8f560eff.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

5595|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

5595|ec597f71.name: Ironforge Guard
5595|ec597f71.text: Ah, I believe Gimble Thistlefuzz is who ye'll be needing if yer looking to learn the Enchanter's profession.  Ye'll find Gimble in his shop, Thistlefuzz Arcanery, right by the Gryphon Master at The Great Forge.

5624|0c7d0821.name: Undercity Guardian
5624|0c7d0821.text: Lady stitch us up and bandage when we get hit.  You find her in inner ring of Rogues' Quarter.

5819|88989ac8.name: Mirelle Tremayne
5819|88989ac8.text:
If you're looking for plate armor, mail armor or shields, I've got the finest in all of Undercity. Most of these pieces are made and repaired here locally, though some are scavenged.

Feel free to browse.

658|003beda2.name: Sten Stoutarm
658|003beda2.text: Ah, well aren't you a sturdy-looking one? Perhaps you can assist me with a thing or two. Not much help around here except for green apprentices, and they've other things to worry about.

6739|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Bates
6739|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

6741|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Norman
6741|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

714|7dd450ba.name: Talin Keeneye
714|7dd450ba.text: Greetings, $c! Fine day for hunting, wouldn't you say? I've been having more than a little luck with boars, myself. Perhaps you'd like a shot?

727|3005004b.name: Ironforge Mountaineer
727|3005004b.text: Well, ye won't have much luck with finding a tailor out here.  Ironforge is home to a quite a few talented tailors though.  Why don't ye go ask a guard there.

727|7df93155.name: Ironforge Mountaineer
727|7df93155.text: Ye should take a look in Ironforge if ye have yer mind set on enchanting.  I think I saw a shop over by the gryphon master last time I was up there.

727|8f560eff.name: Ironforge Mountaineer
727|8f560eff.text: Which profession trainer would ye be looking for?

727|ce6a7b9d.name: Ironforge Mountaineer
727|ce6a7b9d.text: What do ye need directions to?

786|b76e4f1a.name: Grelin Whitebeard
786|b76e4f1a.text: Greetings, lad. I'm Grelin Whitebeard. I'm here to examine the threat posed by the growing numbers of trolls in Coldridge Valley. What have I found? It's a bit troubling...

836|b62f5856.name: Durnan Furcutter
836|b62f5856.text: I sell the finest cloth and leather garb this side of the valley!

837|5d01ce11.name: Branstock Khalder
837|5d01ce11.text: I hope the Light is with you, $N. Is there anything I can do for you today?

8508|15b608c8.name: Gretta Ganter
8508|15b608c8.text: Lookin' to fish? Then you'll need the proper tools.

179-progress.name: Sten Stoutarm
179-progress.text: Wolves giving you a bit of trouble? You'd do well to avoid the fangs and claws and other sharp bits, yes?
179-progress.title: Dwarven Outfitters

2160-progress.name: Tannok Frosthammer
2160-progress.text: Hi there! Come in, take a seat by the fire and warm yourself with a flagon of ale.
2160-progress.title: Supplies to Tannok

233-progress.name: Talin Keeneye
233-progress.text: Yes? Do you have something for me?
233-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

234-progress.name: Grelin Whitebeard
234-progress.text: Is there something I can help you with?
234-progress.title: Coldridge Valley Mail Delivery

282-progress.name: Mountaineer Thalos
282-progress.text:
Hail! Have a care, $N, the tunnel to Dun Morogh is infested with troggs and is not safe for travel.

If you haven't any pressing business in Dun Morogh, I'll have to ask you to remain in Anvilmar until the tunnel is safer.
282-progress.title: Senir's Observations

291-progress.name: Senator Barin Redstone
291-progress.text: Hmm... it would seem that my guards are becoming less discriminatory with petitioners. Well, what do you want? Make it quick.
291-progress.title: The Reports

308-progress.name: Jarven Thunderbrew
308-progress.text: Hmph! There is all this booze down here, but I have strict orders not to touch it. If only I could get a taste of some of our Thunder Ale...that would sharpen my wits, no lying!
308-progress.title: Distracting Jarven

310-progress.name: Unknown
310-progress.text: The date on this barrel shows that it'll soon be tapped.
310-progress.title: Bitter Rivals

312-progress.name: Tundra MacGrann
312-progress.text: Were you able to get into my meat locker, $N?
312-progress.title: Tundra MacGrann's Stolen Stash

313-progress.name: Pilot Stonegear
313-progress.text: Hey, $N.  Been to the Grizzled Den yet?  Those Wendigos can be fierce.
313-progress.title: The Grizzled Den

315-progress.name: Rejold Barleybrew
315-progress.text: Do you have that shimmerweed?  I almost have a batch of stout ready to brew, and I want to try throwing the weed in with this mixture.
315-progress.title: The Perfect Stout

317-progress.name: Pilot Bellowfiz
317-progress.text: Preparations are going well.  How goes your hunting?
317-progress.title: Stocking Jetsteam

3361-progress.name: Felix Whindlebolt
3361-progress.text:
Oh goodness $N, this town is not well suited for the likes of me.  There are as many nasty creatures here as there were in Gnomeregan before the accident!

Do you have my belongings?  If you don't, then who knows what the trolls have done with them now...
3361-progress.title: A Refugee's Quandary

3364-progress.name: Durnan Furcutter
3364-progress.text: Aye, I'm Durnan Furcutter.  You have something for me?
3364-progress.title: Scalding Mornbrew Delivery

3365-progress.name: Nori Pridedrift
3365-progress.text: I trust the scalding mornbrew got to Durnan on time!  Did you remember to bring me back my mug?
3365-progress.title: Bring Back the Mug

384-progress.name: Ragnar Thunderbrew
384-progress.text: I'm going to need six crag boar ribs and a mug of Rhapsody Malt, $N.
384-progress.title: Beer Basted Boar Ribs

400-progress.name: Beldin Steelgrill
400-progress.text:
Hm?  You look a little young to be a siege engine pilot.  But no matter...do you need something fixed?

Well take a number and get comfortable.  I'm working on a couple engines right now and won't have time for another job for at least a few days.

Or, were you here for something else...?
400-progress.title: Tools for Steelgrill

408-progress.name: Magistrate Sevren
408-progress.text: Time is not a luxury we have, $N.  With each passing hour, the Scourge's hold on Tirisfal Glades grows more firm.
408-progress.title: The Family Crypt

411-progress.name: Bethor Iceshard
411-progress.text: Have you returned Gunther's book?  Has he responded?
411-progress.title: The Prodigal Lich Returns

412-progress.name: Razzle Sprysprocket
412-progress.text: The Recombobulator will be up and running as soon as we have sufficient Restabilization Cogs and Gyromechanic Gears.
412-progress.title: Operation Recombobulation

420-progress.name: Senir Whitebeard
420-progress.text: How are you? Like to share a drink with me, perhaps? Not much else to do in the cold.
420-progress.title: Senir's Observations

445-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
445-progress.text: What business do you have with me, $c?
445-progress.title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

5541-progress.name: Hegnar Rumbleshot
5541-progress.text: I hope you're not here for ammo, because I'm almost out!
5541-progress.title: Ammo for Rumbleshot

5625-complete.name: Maxan Anvol
5625-complete.text:
Well done, $N. You got the Light inside you, that's for sure.

Here, take this robe. It'll denote your role in the church and help people recognize you as a $c--wear it if you want.

Later, there will be more tests that you'll have to go through. Do what you can to learn about your abilities and what you're capable of. Try your hand at a fight or two alone, and then again with other travelers.

But don't fret none... you're as powerful as they come.
5625-complete.title: Garments of the Light

6321-progress.name: Karos Razok
6321-progress.text: You appear to be on official business...
6321-progress.title: Supplying the Sepulcher

6322-progress.name: Michael Garrett
6322-progress.text: If you must travel a long distance, then a bat is your best option.
6322-progress.title: Michael Garrett

6323-progress.name: Gordon Wendham
6323-progress.text: I keep my weapons in top condition.  They are cleaned and ready for use.
6323-progress.title: Ride to the Undercity

6324-progress.name: Deathguard Podrig
6324-progress.text: $N, you return.  Do you have our supplies from the Undercity?
6324-progress.title: Return to Podrig

7813-progress.name: Ralston Farnsley
7813-progress.text:
We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Undercity for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
7813-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

94824-accept.name: Maxan Anvol
94824-accept.text:
Time's come for you to head to Ironforge, $N. High Priestess Mims in the Hall of Mysteries commands you to come speak with her. Gotta be somethin' really good or really bad for the High Priestess to want you there personally, but I'm guessin' you've only done well for yourself and it's a good thing that she wants to speak to ya.

But don't waste too much time 'round here. I'd head there as soon as you can.
94824-accept.title: Confounding Flash

94824-complete.name: High Priestess Mims
94824-complete.text: You took your time arriving, $N. But you can be excused given your dedicated service to the Light. Please pay close attention to this lesson.
94824-complete.title: Confounding Flash

95314-progress.name: Carolai Anise
95314-progress.text: I trust you did not get lost?
95314-progress.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

96628-progress.name: Eric Brighthammer
96628-progress.text: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?
96628-progress.title: The Adventurer

97277-progress.name: Grund Drokda
97277-progress.text: Poor Goz is more concerned for his mecha-walker than himself. Says if anyone gets a hold of that mechanic's log he's greased. Hah! That's why I told him he should just leave his work at home!
97277-progress.title: Grund and Gozwin

98321-accept.name: Tognus Flintfire
98321-accept.text:
Hoha! Good to see a $r who's not afraid to get their hands dirty.

If yer lookin' fer work, I'm afraid I'm a little short on supplies at the moment. Our most reliable source of ore has been overrun by wendigo and now the cave has been abandoned. The miners had to drop everything when they fled!

Say, why don't ye poke yer head around the Grizzled Den to the west and see if you can find some of our missing shipments. It would save us a great deal o' trouble.
98321-accept.title: Flintfire's Shipment

98321-progress.name: Tognus Flintfire
98321-progress.text: Wendigos are nasty beasties. It's just good all the miners made it out of the Grizzled Den in one piece!
98321-progress.title: Flintfire's Shipment

98323-progress.name: Senir Whitebeard
98323-progress.text:
Ah, you're back just in time.

What's the matter, lad? You look like you've seen a ghost.
98323-progress.title: Secure the Mountain

98326-progress.name: Gretta Ganter
98326-progress.text: It'll be a hot day in Dun Morogh before I tell Paxton I lost his entire stockpile to a wendigo.
98326-progress.title: Frosthowl

98545-progress.name: Glix Xizzix
98545-progress.text: What's that? You say that Leonid sent you? Oh boy, haven't seen that crusty old soldier since Naxxramas was raining hell down on our heads.
98545-progress.title: Leonid's Letter

98574-accept.name: Sten Stoutarm
98574-accept.text: While you were helping me out, this memorandum was given to me to pass on to you. Take some time to read it when you have a chance. I'm thinkin' it came from the $c trainer Branstock. Take a gander at it and go find him inside Anvilmar when you've a chance.
98574-accept.title: Hallowed Memorandum

98574-complete.name: Branstock Khalder
98574-complete.text: With time and practice, you'll discover new facets to the Light. In a way, it's finding a union between what you think and what you feel. As you deepen your connection with the Light, you can come back to me to talk about what you've learned. I'll be happy to show you how to tap into that force to teach ya how to heal, or to smite the wicked. For a small donation, of course!
98574-complete.title: Hallowed Memorandum

98574-progress.name: Branstock Khalder
98574-progress.text: Ah, another $r comin' ta learn about the Light! You'll find that deepening your connection to the Light relies on curiosity and intelligence, qualities that many gnomes have in abundance. The way o' the Light isn't a technical discipline, it's a riddle, and one that provides both life lessons and practical blessings.
98574-progress.title: Hallowed Memorandum

99152-progress.name: Hilda the Breaker
99152-progress.text: You'd best not be returning empty-handed. I either need the bones I asked for, or your body on a stretcher to confirm you at least gave it your all trying to get them.
99152-progress.title: As Above, So Below

99153-progress.name: Ephram Barbaro
99153-progress.text: Did you find the damned thing?
99153-progress.title: The One That Got Away

99158-accept.name: Maxan Anvol
99158-accept.text:
There's a $c out in the mountains that belongs to an organization called the Argent Dawn. They're a holy group that is dedicated to finding and destroying the unholy and unnatural.

Father Gavin though, he's mostly the type that seeks to help and heal everyone rather than grab a weapon. He's fixed up an old building to serve as a rest spot for travelers and called it Misty Pine Refuge. I've got a shipment of holy candles that I need to get him. Could you bring them to him if you're going that way?
99158-accept.title: Dawn in the Mountains

99158-progress.name: Father Gavin
99158-progress.text: Why did the Light guide you here today?
99158-progress.title: Dawn in the Mountains

99159-progress.name: Father Gavin
99159-progress.text: Light guide you on your tasks.
99159-progress.title: Finding Warmth
